fluff.overview: Lyran infantry draw confidence from knowing their equipment is first-rate, even when assigned to garrison duty on worlds far from the front lines. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Equipped with Maxell PL-10 laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the more effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
